main_text.l: Apud Ricardum Chiswell, ad insigne Rosæ Coronatæ in Cœmiterio Paulino, MDCLXXXIX.

page.notes: The title is set in roman capitals and small capitals, with mixed-case lines in roman and italic. The historiae line reads "Historiæ" in the scan, transcribed as printed.
